verdict.rationale: 1Password documents its own export feature in its apps, explicitly for moving your information to a different app, which covers the core of the 'leave' story. The evidence never names the export formats or says all data types are included; CSV and the Credential Exchange standard appear only on the import side, and the CLI's item listing is a building block, so neither earns credit here. Missing for 10: documented open export formats (e.g., CSV/JSON/CXF), confirmation that all data types (attachments, passkeys, etc.) are exportable, independent or hands-on corroboration of a complete export.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: You can export your information from the 1Password apps if you want to move it to a different app.
